question: Low interest rate leads to risky money flow into stock and consumer spending. Evaluate the data to verify the accuracy of this statement.
query: SELECT      SUM(CASE WHEN interest_rate < 0 THEN trading_volume ELSE 0 END) AS low_interest_rate_trading_volume,     SUM(CASE WHEN interest_rate < 0 THEN consumer_spending ELSE 0 END) AS low_interest_rate_consumer_spending,     AVG(open_price) OVER (WHERE interest_rate < 0),     AVG(close_price) OVER (WHERE interest_rate < 0) FROM finance_economics_dataset LIMIT 50;
